title: UCT scores and Monte Carlo tree search on Nim
brief: Score actions with the UCT rule, then grow a search tree on Nim whose backup flips the value's sign at each ply, until the search finds the winning move.
hints: uct_scores is q + c * sqrt(log(n_parent) / n). Silence the division warning with np.errstate, then replace the entries where n == 0 with np.inf.
Keep a dict from state to two arrays, N and W, with one entry per action in game.actions(state). The mean is W / N where N > 0.
In the backup, negate the value before adding it at each step up the path. The parent's player is the opponent.
Break ties between equal scores at random with rng.choice(np.flatnonzero(scores == scores.max())).
